label: r4c2
name: D4 late-mirror head
hypothesis: Mirrors after local features rather than before. A centred symmetric convolution first computes 32-channel footprint features from the full trunk features. The 8 D4 copies of those rich local features are then mixed by a 1x1 layer into per-type logits. Each logit can then read full local evidence at its mirrored positions, not just 8 reduced channels, which should fit a flipped or transposed action layout better. Refuted if dev and training success are both 0.
